extras: The plugin operates entirely locally, writing only to Markdown frontmatter and plugin data files, and does not use remote AI services.
intentEvidence: Baixiao Reading Cockpit helps you manage reading progress and turn notes into a reviewable knowledge workflow — dashboard, queue, annual heatmap, all local.
problem: Users need a structured way to track reading status and systematically convert raw notes into a reviewable knowledge workflow.
summary: A dashboard plugin that scans Markdown notes to manage reading progress, group notes by status, and visualize knowledge retention via heatmaps.
